newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HILLS MOTOR SAYS JULY TRAFFIC UP 6.5 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HILLS MOTOR SAYS JULY TRAFFIC UP 6.5 PCT.

text.p: Tollroad operator Hills Motorway Ltd said on Friday that average daily traffic on Sydney's M2 Motorway rose 6.5 percent in July to 42,398 vehicles.
The figure was up from 39,801 vehicles in June, but well below the prospectus forecast of 72,000 each day by the end of 1998.
However, Hills said in a statement that insufficient time had elapsed to establish any long-term traffic patterns on the motorway.
June was the motorway's first full month of operation.
Shares in Hills have eased back in recent months from an intraday high of A$2.42 on concerns about long-term use of the motorway.
Broker J.B. Were late last month estimated long term average daily traffic volumes of about 49,800 vehicles.
Hills shares were trading two cents lower at A$2.03 at 11.45 a.m. (0145 GMT).
